The decisive lesson of the project: exact reproduction, second-seed confirmation, clean nulls and a strictly positive source-clustered interval are not evidence of online gain when the replay is not a faithful image of the physical serving chain. The 9.1x replay-to-online shrink calibration is retired as a predictor; it rested on a single observation and failed on the sign at a nearly identical offline magnitude. Evidence is preserved deliberately.
